description: Make a season live on the series page. Refused, with the editor's message, until the season has an episode with a playable video (the episode itself may still be a draft: publishing the season is what lets its episodes be published with publish_episode). The series itself goes public with publish_film.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

name: publish_season
title: Publish a season
